title: Block Git Reset Hard
summary: A Claude Code hook that blocks git reset --hard and forced git clean in the shell, so uncommitted work is never wiped without you running it.
description: Two git commands erase work that no commit holds: reset with the hard option and clean with force. This PreToolUse hook refuses both when the agent tries them in Bash.
A clean run with the dry-run flag still passes, since it only lists files. The message points the agent to stash or a scratch branch, which keep the work recoverable.
useWhen: Let an agent try risky fixes without losing your edits
Protect untracked files such as local notes
Work in a dirty tree on purpose
Keep a safety net during large refactors

hook.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',x=>d+=x).on('end',()=>{let j={};try{j=JSON.parse(d)}catch(e){return}const i=j.tool_input||{};const c=String(i.command||'').replace(/\x22[^\x22]*\x22|\x27[^\x27]*\x27/g,' ')+' ';const t=c.split(/&&|[|][|]|[;|]/).map(s=>s+String.fromCharCode(32));const reset=t.find(s=>/^[ ]*git[ ]+reset[ ].*--hard/.test(s));const clean=t.find(s=>/^[ ]*git[ ]+clean[ ]/.test(s)&&/[ ](-[a-zA-Z]*f[a-zA-Z]*|--force)[ ]/.test(s)&&!/[ ](-[a-zA-Z]*n[a-zA-Z]*|--dry-run)[ ]/.test(s));const h=reset?'git reset --hard':clean?'git clean with force':'';if(h){console.error('Blocked: '+h+' throws away uncommitted work for good. Use git stash or a new branch to keep it, or ask the user to run this command themselves.');process.exitCode=2}})"

example.prompt: Undo everything and get back to a clean tree with git reset --hard.
example.result: The command is blocked. The agent offers to stash your changes first and asks whether you want to run the reset yourself.

faq.question: Is git reset --soft allowed?
faq.answer: Yes. Only the hard option is refused, because soft and mixed resets keep your file contents intact.

faq.question: Can I preview what clean would delete?
faq.answer: Yes. git clean -n or --dry-run is allowed and lists the files without removing anything.

access: Reads each Bash command before it runs
Blocks matching commands and runs nothing itself
